note: Phase dates and a typical week for each phase, shown at the top of each phase tab on the coach Docs page.

0.name: Phase 0 - Transition & Pre-Testing Prep
0.dateNote: If a consolation game moves the final game a week later, Phase 0 starts Mon Nov 2 and the recovery block shrinks to one week.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 6-7 weeks: 1-2 recovery weeks, then 5 weeks of optional prep sessions

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: Prep sessions Tue and Thu, about 30-35 min, coach-run, attendance optional

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Recover, then ramp back into training so athletes arrive at Testing Week able to produce a real 5RM

keyDates: Prep sessions run Nov 10 - Dec 10 (nine sessions); Thanksgiving Break (Nov 26-27) cuts Thursday of Prep Week 3.
Testing Week opens Mon Dec 14. Fewer than four Prep sessions attended means no heavy 5RM in Testing Week.

days.title: Prep session
lines: NMT warm-up
Bodyweight circuit: squat, push-up, row, RDL reach, plank
Weeks 2-5 add a light barbell touch (RPE 6 or below)

days.title: Prep session
lines: Same format as Tuesday
Weeks 4-5 rotate which lifts get the barbell touch

progression: Weeks 1-2 (recovery): no training, nothing expected. If something hurts, tell the athletic trainer.
Prep Week 1: bodyweight only, plus 10-12 min easy conditioning.
Prep Week 2: empty bar for squat and bench, technique only.
Prep Week 3: short week, one session, bodyweight only.
Prep Week 4: light barbell touches on all four lifts, RPE 5-6.
Prep Week 5: movement screen only. Arrive fresh for Testing Week.

1.name: Phase 1 - Winter
1.dateNote: Testing Week Dec 14-18. Winter Break (no training) Dec 21 - Jan 3. Training Weeks 2-9 run Jan 4 - Feb 26.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 9 weeks: Testing Week, then 8 training weeks

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: 4 lifts a week (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri), about 55 min each (estimate)

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Max strength and hypertrophy: build the base

keyDates: Week 6 (Feb 1-5) is the retest week. Weeks 5 and 9 are the peak weeks.
Weeks 2, 4 and 8 are lighter 3-set weeks.
Mon Jan 18, Mon Feb 8 and Mon Feb 15 have no school: Day A moves to Tuesday and Day B to Wednesday that week.

days.title: Day A - Squat
lines: Back Squat, 4 x 5 at the week's % of e1RM
Accessory circuit: DB bench, cable row, core, calf raise
Finisher: shoulder health, lateral bound

days.title: Day B - Hinge
lines: Deadlift (even weeks) or Romanian Deadlift (odd weeks), 4 x 5
Circuit: DB overhead press, pull-up, leg press, Pallof press
Finisher: shoulder health, lateral bound, Nordic

days.title: Day C - Push
lines: Bench Press, 4 x 5, plus one back-off set of 10-12
Circuit: front or goblet squat, DB row, lunge, hanging knee raise
Finisher: shoulder health

days.title: Day D - Pull
lines: Pull-up (weighted or bodyweight track), 4 x 5
Barbell overhead press, 3 x 5
Circuit: single-leg RDL, step-up, woodchopper
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic

2.name: Phase 2 - Spring
2.dateNote: Testing Week Mar 1-5. Spring Break (no training) Mar 26 - Apr 2. Phase 2-3 Bridge (Tue/Fri maintenance sessions) May 25 - Jun 15.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 11 weeks: Testing Week, then 10 training weeks

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: 4 lifts a week (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri), each with a Strength Lane and a Power Lane

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Strength-speed and power: turn the winter base into fast, football-specific force

keyDates: Week 5 (Apr 5-9), the first week back from Spring Break, runs a lighter 78% x 3 Strength Lane.
Week 7 (Apr 19-23) is the retest week: test days only, no power work.
Fri Apr 9 is a single-session school day; Day D still runs at a time the coach sets.

days.title: Day A - Squat
lines: Strength Lane: Back Squat, 3 work sets
Power Lane: Trap Bar Jump Squat, 5 x 3 light and fast
Circuit: split squat, core, calf raise
Finisher: shoulder health

days.title: Day B - Hinge
lines: Strength Lane: Deadlift or Romanian Deadlift, 3 work sets
Power Lane: Trap Bar Jump Shrug, 5 x 3
Circuit: DB overhead press, pull-up, lateral lunge, Pallof press
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic

days.title: Day C - Push
lines: Strength Lane: Bench Press, 3 work sets
Power Lane: CAT Bench Press, 5 x 3 at 50-70%, max bar speed
Circuit: front or goblet squat, DB row, lunge, hanging knee raise
Finisher: shoulder health

days.title: Day D - Pull / Rotational
lines: Strength Lane: Pull-up (weighted or bodyweight track)
Power Lane: landmine rotational press or med ball throw, 4 x 5 per side
Circuit: barbell overhead press, single-leg RDL, step-up, side plank
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic

3.name: Phase 3 - Early Summer
3.dateNote: Testing Window Mon-Tue Jun 21-22. Training Weeks 2-4 run Jun 28 - Jul 15. Fridays are open.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 4 weeks: Testing Window, two training weeks, retest week

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: 4 a week (Mon-Thu), then a football practice segment (about 45 min) right after each one

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Speed and conditioning once school is out and full days are free

keyDates: Week 4 (Jul 12-15) is the retest week: speed Monday, conditioning Thursday, no sled or SIT work.
Heat: an on-site WBGT reading is taken before every outdoor session, including Wednesday's outdoor practice.

days.title: Day A - Acceleration & Sled
lines: NMT warm-up (10-13 min), acceleration mechanics
Sled pulls, then unresisted sprints
Skill positions add flying sprints
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic
Then offense install (about 45 min)

days.title: Day B - Tempo & Skills
lines: NMT warm-up
Tempo runs, 6-8 x 100m at 70-75%
Skills circuit: 4 change-of-direction stations
Then 7v7 (about 45 min)

days.title: Day D - Maintenance Lift (indoors)
lines: NMT warm-up
Bench, pull-up, overhead press: 3 x 5 at about 80%
Squat and deadlift: 2 x 5 at about 60% (returning athletes)
Finisher: shoulder health
Then 7v7 outdoors (about 45 min)

days.title: Day C - Plyometrics & SIT
lines: NMT warm-up
Plyo circuit: box jump, broad jump, bounds
SIT conditioning: repeated max shuttle sprints
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic
Then offense install (about 45 min)

4.name: Phase 4 - Pre-Camp Taper
4.dateNote: Then a no-contact blackout week (estimated starting about Aug 2) and camp (NJSIAA's chart lists Aug 9 as the tentative first practice).

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 2 weeks: quality week, then deep taper

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: 4 a week (Mon-Thu), same days as Phase 3, with a practice segment after each

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Arrive at camp fresh, not fried

keyDates: Week 1 holds one heavy sled touch and the last real lift. Week 2 drops the sled, the conditioning and most of the volume.
First-time athletes test Squat in Week 1's Day D and Deadlift in Week 2's Day D, a week apart, never in one session.
Week 2's Friday (Jul 30) takes no makeups: a missed Week 2 session is simply missed.

days.title: Day A - Heavy sled & speed
lines: Reduced acceleration mechanics
One sled touch: 3 x 10m
2 unresisted sprints, 10-20m
Finish: shoulder health, then Nordic 2 x 8-10

days.title: Day B - Tempo & skills
lines: Tempo runs, 4-5 x 100m
Skills circuit, 2 reps per station

days.title: Day D - Maintenance lift
lines: Bench, pull-up, overhead press: 3 x 5 at about 80%
Squat and deadlift: 2 x 5 at about 60%
First-timers: Squat 5RM test goes first today

days.title: Day C - Plyos & conditioning
lines: Plyo circuit, near Phase 3 volume
SIT conditioning cut to 1 set of 4
Finish: shoulder health, then Nordic 2 x 8-10

days.title: Day A - Speed touch (no sled)
lines: Light acceleration mechanics
2 sprints, 10-15m

days.title: Day B - Tempo & skills (light)
lines: Tempo runs, 3 x 100m
Skills circuit at walkthrough pace

days.title: Day D - Taper lift
lines: Bench, pull-up, overhead press: 2 x 5 at about 75%
Squat and deadlift: 2 x 5 at about 60%
First-timers: Deadlift 5RM test goes first today

days.title: Day C - Plyos (low volume)
lines: Plyo circuit, fewer reps, full quality
No conditioning
Finish: shoulder health, then Nordic 2 x 8-10

5.name: Phase 5 - In-Season
5.dateNote: Placeholder until Dover's 2027 schedule is published. Camp Bridge covers the stretch from Phase 4's last session to the season opener: blackout week (estimated about Aug 2-8), then camp (NJSIAA's tentative first practice, Aug 9).

facts.label: Length
facts.value: The regular season, about 8 weeks

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: 2 short lifts a week (about 30-40 min), plus a trimmed NMT warm-up before every practice

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Maintain strength and power while managing total weekly load

keyDates: Weeks 1-2 of the season run a lower re-entry ramp on Squat and Deadlift (70%, then 78% of e1RM).

Saturday game: lifts move to Tuesday and Thursday (Monday is practice only). Thursday game: no Sunday session, so only one lift day runs (Squat + Bench on Monday); the Deadlift/Pull-up day is skipped, not made up.
A missed lift is not made up in season. First-time athletes load each lift off its own test: Bench and Pull-up from Phase 3, Squat and Deadlift from Phase 4.
During camp, once two-a-days begin, one weekly maintenance lift resumes (see Camp Bridge).

days.title: GD-4 - Lift Day 1
lines: Squat and Bench Press, 3 x 3-5 at about 80-85%
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic

days.title: GD-3 - Practice only
lines: Trimmed NMT warm-up before practice
No barbell work

days.title: GD-2 - Lift Day 2
lines: Deadlift and Pull-up, 3 x 3-5 at about 80-85%
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic

days.title: GD-1 - Walkthrough
lines: Trimmed NMT warm-up
No barbell work, no added conditioning

days.title: Game day
lines: No S&C session. NMT is the team's own pregame routine.

days.title: Day after
lines: Full rest, or optional light mobility

Phase 2–3 Bridge.name: Phase 2–3 Bridge
Phase 2–3 Bridge.dateNote: Tuesday and Friday. Five confirmed dates: May 25, Jun 4, Jun 8, Jun 11, Jun 15. May 28 and Jun 1 are bonus dates that only happen if the district uses its emergency school days. Testing Window opens Mon Jun 21, six days after the last session.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 3 weeks, 5 confirmed sessions (7 if both bonus dates run)

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: 2 a week: Tuesday (Track Day 1) and Friday (Track Day 2), about 55-65 min each

facts.label: Who
facts.value: Voluntary and coach-judged, same as the Multi-Sport Maintenance Track. Spring-sport athletes already on the track simply keep going.

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Close the 4.5-week gap so nobody goes cold into Testing Window sprinting. A cold-start safety measure, not a strength builder.

keyDates: Memorial Day (Mon May 31) and graduation (Thu Jun 17) are why it runs Tuesday/Friday instead of Monday/Thursday.
Loads are held at Phase 2 Week 11's level. Jun 4 runs at 78% e1RM because it comes 10 days after May 25.

days.title: Track Day 1 - Squat + Push
lines: NMT warm-up (trimmed)
Back Squat, then Trap Bar Jump Squat 5 x 3
Bench Press, then CAT Bench Press 5 x 3
Finisher: shoulder health, light DB overhead press 2 x 10-12, Nordic

days.title: Track Day 2 - Hinge + Pull
lines: NMT warm-up (trimmed)
Deadlift or Romanian Deadlift, then Trap Bar Jump Shrug 5 x 3
Pull-up (weighted or bodyweight track)
Finisher: shoulder health, Nordic

Camp Bridge.name: Camp Bridge
Camp Bridge.dates: About Aug 2 to the season opener, early September 2027
Camp Bridge.dateNote: All dates are estimates. Phase 4 ends Thu Jul 29. Blackout week is estimated Aug 2-8, with NJSIAA's first practice tentatively Aug 9 and then a 14-day heat-acclimatization ramp. The football staff runs camp; this program only covers the lifting and conditioning below.

facts.label: Length
facts.value: 3+ weeks: blackout week, then camp through the season opener

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: One short maintenance lift a week once two-a-days begin. Conditioning is built into practice.

facts.label: Goal
facts.value: Keep strength alive through blackout week and camp so the season opener is not a cold start

keyDates: No lifting in the first 5 days of the heat ramp: single practice a day, capped at 3 hours, helmets only the first two days.
Phase 5 then opens with a re-entry ramp on Squat and Deadlift: 70%, then 78% of e1RM in season Weeks 1-2.

days.title: Blackout week
lines: No coach-led training, no contact

days.title: Camp, heat ramp
lines: No lifting. Camp practice only.
Conditioning ramps: 1 set of 4 on Days 1-2, 2 sets of 4 on Days 3-5

days.title: Weekly maintenance lift
lines: Once a week, in whichever session leaves the most room
Bench, pull-up, overhead press: 2 x 5 at about 75%
Squat and deadlift: 2 x 5 at about 60%
Bodyweight pull-up track: 2 x 5, 2-3 reps in reserve

days.title: End-of-practice conditioning
lines: Phase 3's SIT format: 20m out-and-back shuttles. Volume follows the ramp day: 1 x 4 (Days 1-2), 2 x 4 (Days 3-5), 2 x 5 from Day 6
30 sec between reps, about 3 min between sets; linemen get 25% more recovery. Rest is never shortened to fit more volume
On an Orange or Red WBGT day this segment is cut first
